title: Technical Support Group leader
description:
Why This Role Exists The MR business is carrying a recurring, escalating problem: field issues at customer sites are consuming the time of Physical-AI NPD engineers, who are the people responsible for building the long-term platform franchise. The reason this happens is structural the Technical Support Group (TSG), the function that should sit between the field (I&C L1) and engineering (NPD), is leaderless, understaffed, and underskilled. A leaderless group cannot self-improve, cannot triage incoming work, and cannot say no to overflow. The consequence is not just a delivery gap it is a strategic drain that mortgages the future to pay for the present. The TSG Team Lead is the single most important appointment in the MR value stream right now. Without this person in place, no other TSG action staffing, skilling, certification will hold. With this person in place, the reinforcing loop (ship incomplete site firefight NPD pulled platform delayed more bespoke pressure) can be broken. Role Mission Financial impact: Contribute partl to the 912 Cr savings target through I&C savings reduce rework man-days, accelerate ramp-up, and eliminate site escalations that consume engineering cost. Protect the Physical-AI NPD franchise from being consumed by short-term site firefighting. Functional impact: Build, lead, and continuously improve the TSG (L2) as the definitive buffer between field execution (I&C L1) and engineering (NPD Design). Own the technical resolution of all L2 field issues, the NPD Firewall, and the standard-track validation capability for the two-tier pre-ship gate. Emotional impact: Create a TSG that the I&C team trusts to escalate to without hesitation, that customers feel safe in the hands of, and that NPD engineers are confidently protected by so the team that builds the future can stay focused on the future. Deploy customer-confidence communication protocol with Site Incharges time-bound recovery plans that rebuild trust.
